entries.land_location_as_stated: Frankfort, ME; mid-coast; woods; uncultivated farmland
entries.description: An emerging lesbian community on 100 acres of woods and uncultivated farmland in Frankfort, Maine, initiated by a working-class lesbian separatist currently living in Boston. Plans include permanent structures and a lesbian burial ground. Welcoming lesbian women, girl children, older women, working-class women, and women in recovery. Strictly substance-free.
entries.raw_text: DUTCH MOUNTAIN c/o Eileen Kennedy, 91 Rossmore Rd #3, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130 (617)522-2472 (Frankfort, ME, 12 mi from Belfast; mid-coast). I am a 39-year-old working class Lesbian separatist, artist and environmental educator with a long-time dream of an intergenerational Lesbian community (from infancy to very elderly), including a Lesbian burial ground. I'm currently living in Boston, but building May, Sept & Oct 86 - finally! Write c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438 while I'm building. I will need a dyke(s) to cabinsit or rent real cheap through winter and maybe longer. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children, older lesbians, artists, working class dykes, 12-step Program dykes. No alcohol or drugs of any kind. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 100 acres, housing/permanent structure this year, camping space, woods, uncultivated farmland.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned/initiated by one woman ('I am a 39-year-old working class Lesbian separatist... I have/am: 1 lesbian') who does not yet live there full-time. num_residents is 0 because she is 'currently living in Boston, but building May, Sept & Oct 86'. Land location inferred from '(Frankfort, ME, 12 mi from Belfast; mid-coast)' and General Delivery Frankfort, ME 04438. Focuses include Older women ('intergenerational Lesbian community (from infancy to very elderly)', 'older lesbians'), Recovery/substance-free ('12-step Program dykes. No alcohol or drugs of any kind'), Working-class women ('working class Lesbian separatist', 'working class dykes'), and Lesbian separatism ('Lesbian separatist'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women and Girl children ('girl children').

entries.land_location_as_stated: off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake; ponds; woods; farmland
entries.description: A 100-acre farm and retreat space on Silver Lake in Massachusetts with woods, ponds, organic gardens, small livestock, and bees, lived and worked on by two women and a girl child. Offers secluded outdoor space for workshops, retreats, and camping. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, children of all genders, and men conditionally.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM PO Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-8826 (off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake). We offer scenic grounds and meaningful work experience with easy access to Boston and Cape Cod - secluded outdoor space available to groups and individuals for workshops, retreats, etc. Accomodations are rough (outhouse, barn kitchen) - ponds for swimming, fishing, canoe - organic gardens, small livestock, bees. Usual donation for camping $6 a night. We welcome: new members, girl & boy children, non-lesbian women, males (maybe), dogs on leashes, horses. BYO food. We have/are: two with a girl child, 100 acres, 1 house, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type coded as Retreat/Gathering Space because the listing is defined by what it offers visitors ('secluded outdoor space available to groups and individuals for workshops, retreats, etc.', rough accommodations, camping donations). Alternatively could be considered Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('two with a girl child'), but the focus is providing gathering and workshop space. num_residents is 3 based on 'two with a girl child' and 'women living and working on the land'. Land location in MA inferred from mailing address and '(off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake)'. Accepted groups include all six categories: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('non-lesbian women'), Girl children ('girl & boy children'), Boy children ('girl & boy children'), and Gay men and Non-gay men ('males (maybe)'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('organic gardens, small livestock, bees'); per codebook, this does not count as Environmentalism/eco-friendly.
